Using the provided own-generated plant sprites only as detailed naturalistic pixel ART STYLE, scale-language, camera and warm upper-left-light reference, author a NEW actual production PARTS SHEET for TWO native garden plants. Output1536x1024 landscape, TRUE transparent RGBA alpha. Exactly SIX completely separated components arranged in a strict3columns x2rows grid. Each cell512x512, every silhouette strictly inside its own cell with at least65pixels fully empty clearance at all cell boundaries. No component touches frame or a sibling. NO text, labels, arrows, guides, UI, birds, pots, scenery, ground tiles or decorative backdrop. No painted background/checkerboard or shadow haze. Real alpha outside all cutouts and through leaf/blade gaps. Detailed deliberate small square pixel clusters, stepped contours, controlled organic palette and subtle selective outline. Crisp naturalistic botanical forms, no blur, photoreal noise or cartoon. Quiet garden assets support birds as focus. Parts should share compatible original scale within each plant, NOT normalize small rootbases to huge whole plants. Every tip/base complete.

TOP ROW = Cleveland sage, Salvia clevelandii, gray-green narrowly oval softly wrinkled opposite leaves and distinct VIOLET WHORLS of small flowers on airy thin stalks; not white-flowered black sage.
TOP LEFT CELL: ONLY the RIGID ROOT/LOW WOODY BASE, a short tan-gray forked root crown about170px wide and180px high, just a few tiny contact pebbles at its bottom and a sparse little collar of low gray-green leaves. Two short thick woody fork arms end in clearly visible plain BLUNT CUT ATTACHMENT STUBS pointing upward-left and upward-right, each about15px wide. Base rooted at lower center, actual contact collar complete. Do not draw a whole shrub or tall flower stalks on base.
TOP MIDDLE CELL: ONE separate flexible LEFT-leaning upper sage branch/foliage module about250px wide and320px high. Two or three airy leafy stems and a few restrained violet flower whorls, organic asymmetric silhouette. All stems converge into ONE short plain tan-gray basal branch stub about15px wide at bottom center. This bottom stub is the attachment pivot; leave last30px of stub free of leaves so it can overlap a rigid-base fork. No roots, soil, pebbles, parent trunk or extra detached sprigs.
TOP RIGHT CELL: ONE matching RIGHT-leaning upper sage branch/foliage module, similarly250px wide320px high, distinct compatible airy gray-green leaf/violet whorl silhouette, ONE short plain15px-wide branch stub bottomcenter with30px clear stem for attachment. No roots/soil/base.

BOTTOM ROW = Deergrass, Muhlenbergia rigens. Fine narrow arching fresh green-to-muted olive grass blades with small straw basal fibers. No blue flowers, broad iris blades, feathery plumes or purple ornamental fountain grass. Nonflowering healthy leaf modules for this assembly; narrow seed stalks belong to later seasonal states, not here.
BOTTOM LEFT CELL: ONLY a RIGID LOW BASAL CROWN about160px wide100px high: compact fibrous tan-green root tuft with short cut blade bases and a very few small contact pebbles, fixed root contact at bottom center. Two small clearly visible green-tan upper attachment sockets left/right at crown top, with a sparse SHORT rigid leaf collar to hide later overlapping fan roots. No tall arching grass fan baked onto crown.
BOTTOM MIDDLE CELL: ONE separate flexible LEFT-ARCHING GRASS FAN module about250px wide310px high, many fine narrow curved green blades, a little straw near base. Blade roots converge tightly to ONE compact18px-wide bundle at bottomcenter, last25px straight/pale and bare for hidden overlap into the crown socket. No roots, pebbles, ground or thick woody stem.
BOTTOM RIGHT CELL: ONE matching separate RIGHT-ARCHING GRASS FAN module,250px wide310px high, distinct fine-bladed silhouette, exactly ONE compact18px basal bundle bottomcenter with25px clear overlapping attachment neck. No root crown, pebbles, soil or flowers.

Six isolated art components ONLY. These are actual separate attachable RGBA parts, not a whole plant drawn across panels and not six full plants. Low rigid bases stay small; upper leaf/stem/fan modules are taller, with explicit clear basal connection necks. Wind preview will rotate only the FOUR upper compound modules about their basal attachment pivots, while both rigid contact bases stay fixed. No animation frames generated or promised, no per-leaf separation implied.

Author THREE NEW DISTINCT WHOLE placeable props, not copies of those old silhouettes. Output1536x1024 landscape TRUE transparent RGBA alpha sheet, exactly THREE isolated complete objects in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, left/middle/right, one object per512px-wide column. Each silhouette stays inside central72percent of its column and central70percent of image height, with at least65px empty gutters on both sides. Do not normalize tiny thickness to tall objects; these are all LOW ground props. Complete objects/contact feet inside frame. No text, labels, arrows, UI, animals, birds, plants, pots beyond named trough, foliage, scene, floor tile or painted backdrop. Real transparent alpha around silhouettes and small tight contact shadows, no matte/checkerboard/halo.

Detailed naturalistic PIXEL ART, deliberate crisp small square clusters and stepped contours, restrained organic value ramps, subtle contour, warm upper-left soft light, three-quarter side view with modest top visibility. Natural quiet objects let birds remain focus; no photoreal noise, smooth airbrushing or cartoon proportions. One compatible understated concrete/weatheredwood theme.

LEFT: a CIRCULAR VERY LOW GROUND BIRDBATH, modest round broad shallow cast-concrete dish with a softly rounded EXPOSED-AGGREGATE gray-beige rim, distinct from reference rectangular bath and rough natural-rock bath. Thin quiet blue-green still water inside shallow sloping basin, broad clearly visible near rim for plausible foot/perch annotation and visible water region for drinking/beak annotation. No pedestal, fountain, pump, landing stone or bird. Two tiny low support feet under the heavy disk, full ground contact visible. No falling or flowing water. Surface is calm stillwater baked in this static whole sprite, no animation.

MIDDLE: matching LOW LONG RECTANGULAR CONCRETE TROUGH PLANTER, a broad horizontal box roughly1.2m wide and0.28m high in design intent, shallow exposed dark dry EMPTY soil cavity. Quiet pale gray-beige cast-concrete with the same fine aggregate family, narrow softly rounded lip and TWO short inset block feet visible at ends. Distinct long low trough shape, not the old square modern planter. No plant, water, blue glaze, pedestal, legs higher than the box, watering can, soil spill or separate accessories. Wholeprop includes cavity/soil/body/feet as flattened art.

RIGHT: LOW WEATHERED HORIZONTAL LOG PERCH. One short thick gray-brown fallen hardwood log with understated bark remnants and a broad upper worn flattened saddle for perching, one visible endgrain end. Very low grounded log, resting on two natural small knobby contact areas that remain part of same log. One complete horizontal low silhouette, NO tall fork, Y-shaped upward branch, rootball, separate stones, grass or birds. Natural restrained grain/cracks with calm muted material, not a bench or carved furniture. Upper saddle clearly visible for actual pixel-based foot/perch points.

Exactly three new static whole props with matching perspective/light and complete contacts. Each part is individually extracted, but its water/wood/soil/foot geometry is NOT separately rigged. No invented interaction implementation or additional isolated accessory pieces.
